title: Diffusion-based Tabular Data Synthesis
summary: A diffusion-model-based tabular data synthesis pipeline (TabDDPM, CTABGAN, CTABGAN+, TVAE, SMOTE) supporting multiple generative models, preprocessing strategies, and ML-efficacy/statistical evaluation. The repository vendors an in-tree copy of the CTGAN library (from sdv-dev/CTGAN, depending on rdt) and imports its TVAESynthesizer to train a TVAE baseline model.
